card.name: Difference in placebo comparison tables
card.fires_on: The word "Difference" in table headings comparing drug and placebo, such as "Drug-Placebo Difference in Number of Cases" or "Risk Difference".

modes.label: Drug-placebo difference heading
modes.description: "Difference" right after "Drug-Placebo" in the antidepressant suicidality table header.

modes.label: Risk difference column
modes.description: "Difference" after "Risk" in a relative-risk table header.

card.writes: It suppresses placeholder tokens like unknown and NA, so it adds no clear content.
card.plain: It marks the word "Difference" in column headings of tables that compare drug and placebo results.
